name: Garrison
label: Revelation
lede: Two kids from Shrewsbury, Massachusetts wrote songs for a year before their first show, then played hundreds more across the US, Europe and Japan, trying to make Drive Like Jehu sound like a pop band.

eras.title: A year of songs before a single show
eras.text: Joe Grillo and Ed McNamara grew up together in Shrewsbury, outside Worcester. McNamara had fronted the math-emo band Iris and run an all-ages room called The Space; Grillo had Stricken for Catherine in New Hampshire. In Boston they wanted something more stripped-down and heavy.

years.h: Joe Grillo and Ed McNamara start writing Garrison in Boston
years.p: Joe Grillo moves to Boston and Ed McNamara follows. They write together for more than a year, with drummer Guy D'Annolfo in early, before playing a note in public.

years.h: Garrison's first show, the day after Stricken for Catherine's last
years.p: With bassist Andy White completing the line-up, Garrison play their first show on June 29, 1998, one day after Joe Grillo's old band Stricken for Catherine played its final one.
Boston's Espo Records presses early Garrison demo material as the 24 7", the band's first release.

eras.title: Songs, not math
eras.text: Garrison signed to Revelation just as Boston's heavy scene was exploding around Converge and Cave In. They recorded with Kurt Ballou and Brian McTernan, toured constantly, and kept insisting they were writing songs, not puzzles.

q: We consciously try to write songs
years.h: The Bend Before the Break · Revelation REV 83
years.p: Garrison's Revelation debut. The first 7" pressing ran 200 copies on green vinyl.
years.xp: Ed McNamara told Lollipop that year the band consciously tried to write songs, honest lyrics inside arrangements that held your attention, rather than technical showing off. Both he and Joe Grillo name-checked The Cure, Pixies, Slint and [[Don Caballero|b93697af-a318-417a-b16e-a9eb47fbe2f8]].

years.h: A Mile in Cold Water, Garrison's first album · REV 93
years.p: Garrison's first full-length on Revelation, recorded in Boston. The first vinyl pressing: 220 copies on opaque blue.

yt: Serious Heavy Drama, cut from 2000 tour footage
years.h: Garrison tour the US with Elliott and Boy Sets Fire
years.p: Garrison spend 2000 on the road with [[Elliott|b3250fd8-d202-4d4a-8fb3-1fdf88176aff]] and Boy Sets Fire. Tour footage later becomes the video for Serious Heavy Drama.

years.h: Garrison split EP with UK band [[Hundred Reasons|32301b5a-a2eb-4575-a070-cc661feb003c]]
years.p: Garrison share a split EP with British band Hundred Reasons, out on Simba Recordings in the UK and Iodine in the US.

years.h: Be a Criminal, Garrison's second album · REV 103
years.p: Garrison's second and last album on Revelation. The vinyl ran 307 on grey and white marble, plus 1,757 black.
Guy D'Annolfo and Andy White's run ends in 2001. Joe Grillo and Ed McNamara carry Garrison on with a changing cast including Jason Carlin, Matt LaVonture and Ethan Dussault.

eras.title: Two EPs and a quiet exit
eras.text: Garrison kept releasing and kept touring, as far as Europe and Japan, before calling it. Nobody agrees on the exact count of shows, but it ran into the hundreds.

years.h: Garrison's last EPs: The Model and The Silhouette
years.p: Garrison release two EPs, The Model and The Silhouette, plus a split with Orange Island on Iodine.

years.h: Garrison break up after hundreds of shows
years.p: Garrison disband after touring the US, Europe and Japan. Ed McNamara joins Campaign for Real Time; Joe Grillo joins [[Gay for Johnny Depp|8fab478a-6800-4b5c-ae98-01d65eeec146]].

eras.title: The vault, then the stage
eras.text: Arctic Rodeo and Iodine went back through Garrison's catalog, with rarities, a vinyl debut for The Bend Before the Break, and A Mile in Cold Water back on LP. The reissues brought the original four back together.

years.h: TV or the Atom Bomb: Garrison's b-sides and rarities
years.p: German label Arctic Rodeo Recordings collects Garrison's singles, b-sides and rarities from across their career.

years.h: The Bend Before the Break on vinyl LP for the first time
years.p: Iodine Recordings issues Garrison's 1999 record as a full LP with unreleased tracks from 1998–2004 and new Dan McCarthy artwork.

years.h: Garrison's original four reunite for three shows
years.p: With A Mile in Cold Water back on LP, Joe Grillo, Ed McNamara, Guy D'Annolfo and Andy White play the Middle East Downstairs in Cambridge, Ralph's Chadwick Diner in Worcester, and The Wooly in Gainesville during The Fest.
